items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: I don't even know those guys. And Wallace played sax.

ctx.x: And he just was called Lil' Willie?

Lil' Willie. That's not a little... No name. Another one, saxophone player. It was called Big Willie. I forget. He played saxophone. Big Willie played tennis sax, and Lil' Willie played drum. I don't even know those guys. And Wallace played sax. They had a whole lot of the guys. Todd Kennedy, trumpet. They were the outstanding. They had a little short guy. Can't think of his name. They played. It was the same. Came all from Texas. And they stayed there. And they broke up after a while. After they were there. I…
You don't know Banjo Buck's right name.
